fn min(a: Int, b: Int) -> Int
  requires (a == a)
  ensures (result == (if (a <= b) then a else b))
  ensures ((result == a) or (result == b))
  ensures (result <= a)
  ensures (result <= b)
  ensures ((not (result == a)) or (a <= b))
  ensures ((not (result == b)) or (b <= a))
  effects pure
  example (min(0, 0) == 0)
  example (min(0, -1) == -1)
{
  if (a <= b) then a else b
}

fn computeInversions(n: Int, k: Int, iterations: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 0)
  requires (iterations >= 0)
  requires (iterations <= min(k, (n / 2)))
  ensures (result == (if (iterations == 0) then 0 else ((computeInversions(n, k, (iterations - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 2))))
  effects pure
  example (computeInversions(1, 0, 0) == 0)
  example (computeInversions(2, 1, 1) == 1)
{
  if (iterations == 0) then 0 else ((computeInversions(n, k, (iterations - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 2))
}

fn sumInversionsFormula(n: Int, iterations: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (iterations >= 0)
  requires (iterations <= (n / 2))
  ensures (result == (if (iterations == 0) then 0 else ((sumInversionsFormula(n, (iterations - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 2))))
  effects pure
  example (sumInversionsFormula(1, 0) == 0)
  example (sumInversionsFormula(2, 1) == 1)
{
  if (iterations == 0) then 0 else ((sumInversionsFormula(n, (iterations - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 1)) + ((n - (2 * (iterations - 1))) - 2))
}

fn solve(n: Int, k: Int) -> Int
  requires (n >= 1)
  requires (k >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == computeInversions(n, k, min(k, (n / 2))))
  ensures (result == sumInversionsFormula(n, min(k, (n / 2))))
  ensures ((not (k >= (n / 2))) or (result == ((n * (n - 1)) / 2)))
  ensures ((not (k < (n / 2))) or (result == (if (k == 0) then 0 else sumInversionsFormula(n, k))))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0, 0) == 0)
{
  0
}
